maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is tuition from students enrolling in degree and bootcamp programs at CTU and AIUS, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Tuition is paid mainly by students, though Title IV federal aid and military or veteran benefits fund part of it.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly organic enrollment at CTU and AIUS; a few acquisitions like Trident, DigitalCrafts, Hippo and Coding Dojo were occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Students can pick other online universities before enrolling, though mid-degree switching costs credits and time, so it is not mission-critical.

notes: Federal Title IV funding is large, so the publicly funded answer is uncertain; I judged the student as the final payer.
